vulnerabilities.name: [CODE-DPDP-001] Personal data flows directly into an unguarded logger sink
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data flows directly into an unguarded logger sink (Statutory: §8(5))
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data flows directly into an unguarded logger sink
Statutory Reference: §8(5)
Ceiling: DPDP Act §8(5) — Up to ₹250 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Wrap sensitive personal data with a masking or tokenization function before logging (e.g. mask_pii(payload)).

vulnerabilities.name: [SQL-DPDP-001] Personal data column defined without column-level encryption marker in database
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data column defined without column-level encryption marker in database schema (Statutory: §8(5))
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data column defined without column-level encryption marker in database schema
Statutory Reference: §8(5)
Ceiling: DPDP Act §8(5) — Up to ₹250 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Enable column-level encryption (e.g. EncryptedType, KMS, or DB pgcrypto) for personal data columns.

vulnerabilities.name: [CODE-DPDP-002] Personal data sent to third-party SDK or external HTTP sink without verified con
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data sent to third-party SDK or external HTTP sink without verified consent guard (Statutory: §7)
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data sent to third-party SDK or external HTTP sink without verified consent guard
Statutory Reference: §7
Ceiling: DPDP Act Residual (§33 Schedule) — Up to ₹50 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Verify explicit user consent prior to dispatching personal data to external services.

vulnerabilities.name: [ARCH-DPDP-001] Application stores personal data in schema, but no consent withdrawal or user er
vulnerabilities.message: Application stores personal data in schema, but no consent withdrawal or user erasure route exists (Statutory: §6(4))
vulnerabilities.description:
Application stores personal data in schema, but no consent withdrawal or user erasure route exists
Statutory Reference: §6(4)
Ceiling: DPDP Act Residual (§33 Schedule) — Up to ₹50 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Implement a dedicated endpoint (e.g. POST /consent/withdraw or DELETE /user/profile) allowing Data Principals to withdraw consent and request erasure.

vulnerabilities.name: [ARCH-DPDP-002] Personal data stored in schema, but no scheduled data purging/erasure routine de
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data stored in schema, but no scheduled data purging/erasure routine detected (Statutory: §8(7))
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data stored in schema, but no scheduled data purging/erasure routine detected
Statutory Reference: §8(7)
Ceiling: DPDP Act Residual (§33 Schedule) — Up to ₹50 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Implement a background job or cron routine to purge personal data whose purpose has expired or whose retention threshold has elapsed.

vulnerabilities.name: [SQL-DPDP-005] Personal data table schema missing verifiable consent ledger linkage reference
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data table schema missing verifiable consent ledger linkage reference (Statutory: §6(1))
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data table schema missing verifiable consent ledger linkage reference
Statutory Reference: §6(1)
Ceiling: DPDP Act Residual (§33 Schedule) — Up to ₹50 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Link personal data records to a consent ledger or consent token column (e.g. consent_id / consent_token).

vulnerabilities.name: [SQL-DPDP-002] Personal data table lacks documented retention period comment in schema
vulnerabilities.message: Personal data table lacks documented retention period comment in schema (Statutory: §8(7))
vulnerabilities.description:
Personal data table lacks documented retention period comment in schema
Statutory Reference: §8(7)
Ceiling: DPDP Act Residual (§33 Schedule) — Up to ₹50 Crore (Discretionary Maximum)
Remediation: Document the statutory retention period in table or column schema comments (e.g. COMMENT ON COLUMN ... 'retention 180 days').
